```{r, include=FALSE}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(corrplot)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(DHARMa)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(knitr)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(ggeffects)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(glmmTMB)
```


# Read in climate and field data
```{r, include=FALSE}
field_climate_08_23_inc <- read.csv("field_climate_08_23_w18_21_growth_NSavgs.csv", row.names=1, na.strings="NA")%>%
  mutate(SHM_mult_dist = (-1*(1 - (SHM/Site_SHM)))*100)%>% #calculate the SHM transfer distance in terms of percent 
  mutate(SHM_mult_dist = round(SHM_mult_dist, digits=3))%>%
  mutate(MAT_dist_sq = MAT_dist^2,
         MAP_dist_sq = MAP_dist^2,
         MCMT_dist_sq = MCMT_dist^2,
         TD_dist_sq = TD_dist^2,
         MSP_dist_sq = MSP_dist^2,
         MWMT_dist_sq = MWMT_dist^2,
         CMD_dist_sq = CMD_dist^2,
         CMI_dist_sq = CMI_dist^2,
         SHM_mult_dist_sq = SHM_mult_dist^2) %>%
  mutate(LD = as.factor(if_else(TS == 1, "L",
                      if_else(TS == 2, "L",
                              if_else(TS == 3, "L","D")))))
field_climate_08_23_inc$Unique_ID <- seq_len(nrow(field_climate_08_23_inc))

field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist))

live_trees <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>% filter(TS==1|TS==2|TS==3) #7881 live trees assessed

dead_trees <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>%filter(LD=='D') %>%dplyr::select("Unique_ID","LD")
# 302 dead trees assessed for sunken bole, pitching on bole, galls
```

# Branch dieback
## Percentiles of interest
0 - 0
0.5x - 25
1x - 51
2x - 102
3x - 153

## Sim 1
```{r,echo=FALSE}
set.seed(25)
#0x - 0 trees
brdbrand_0 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=0), ] %>% mutate(brdb_0 = 1)

#0.5x - 83 trees
brdbrand_05 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=25), ] %>% mutate(brdb_05 = 1)

#1x - 165 trees
brdbrand_1 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=51), ] %>% mutate(brdb_1 = 1)

#2x - 331 trees
brdbrand_2 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=102), ] %>% mutate(brdb_2 = 1)

#3x - 496 trees
brdbrand_3 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=153), ] %>% mutate(brdb_3 = 1)


brdb_sensDD_join <- left_join(dead_trees,brdbrand_0, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,brdbrand_05, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,brdbrand_1, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,brdbrand_2, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,brdbrand_3, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) 

brdb_sensDD_repl <- brdb_sensDD_join %>%
  mutate(brdbrand_0 = if_else(is.na(brdb_0),0, brdb_0))%>%
  mutate(brdbrand_05 = if_else(is.na(brdb_05),0, brdb_05))%>%
  mutate(brdbrand_1 = if_else(is.na(brdb_1),0, brdb_1))%>%
  mutate(brdbrand_2 = if_else(is.na(brdb_2),0, brdb_2))%>%
  mutate(brdbrand_3 = if_else(is.na(brdb_3),0, brdb_3))


tmp_brdb_wDD_sims <- left_join(field_climate_08_23_inc,brdb_sensDD_repl, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(brdbrand_0:brdbrand_3), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), BrDB01, .)))
```

### Standardized variables
```{r, echo=FALSE}
tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$TD_dist_std <- (tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$TD_dist - mean(tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$TD_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$TD_dist))
tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist_std <- (tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist - mean(tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist))
tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$SHM_dist_std <- (tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$SHM_dist - mean(tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$SHM_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_brdb_wDD_sims$SHM_dist))
```

### Models
```{r, echo=FALSE}
modbrdb.OG <- glmmTMB(BrDB01 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = field_climate_08_23_inc, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modbrdb1.DD0x <- glmmTMB(brdbrand_0 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_brdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modbrdb.DD0xboth <- glmmTMB(brdbrand_0 ~ MWMT_dist+  I(MWMT_dist^2) + SHM_dist + I(SHM_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_brdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modbrdb1.DD05x <- glmmTMB(brdbrand_05 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_brdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modbrdb.DD05xlow <- glmmTMB(brdbrand_05 ~ MWMT_dist +  I(MWMT_dist^2) + SHM_dist + I(SHM_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_brdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modbrdb1.DD1x <- glmmTMB(brdbrand_1 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_brdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modbrdb1.DD2x <- glmmTMB(brdbrand_2 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_brdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modbrdb1.DD3x <- glmmTMB(brdbrand_3 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_brdb_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
```

### Tidy dataframes
```{r,echo=FALSE}
modbrdbOG_df<-tidy(modbrdb.OG, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
modbrdbOG_df$model <- "OG"
modbrdbOG_df$multiplier <- "Original model"

sim1brdb0x_df<-tidy(modbrdb1.DD0x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1brdb0x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1brdb0x_df$multiplier <- "0"

sim1brdb05x_df<-tidy(modbrdb1.DD05x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1brdb05x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1brdb05x_df$multiplier <- "0.5x"

sim1brdb1x_df<-tidy(modbrdb1.DD1x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1brdb1x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1brdb1x_df$multiplier <- "1x"

sim1brdb2x_df<-tidy(modbrdb1.DD2x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1brdb2x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1brdb2x_df$multiplier <- "2x"

sim1brdb3x_df<-tidy(modbrdb1.DD3x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1brdb3x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1brdb3x_df$multiplier <- "3x"
```

## Coefficient plots
```{r,echo=FALSE}
brdbcoefs_ALL <- read.csv("BranchDiebackProb_sim_coefs.csv")%>% mutate(term = fct_relevel(term, "(Intercept)", "I(TD_dist_std^2)","TD_dist_std","I(SHM_dist_std^2)","SHM_dist_std","I(MWMT_dist_std^2)","MWMT_dist_std")) %>%
  mutate(multiplier = fct_relevel(multiplier, "0","0.5x","1x","2x","3x", "Original model")) 


pal5_t <- turbo(5, alpha=1, begin=0.2, end=1)
pal6 <- c("#3E9BFEFF", "#46F884FF", "#E1DD37FF", "#F05B12FF", "#7A0403FF","gray")

(coefbrdb<- brdbcoefs_ALL %>% filter(term !="(Intercept)") %>% 
              ggplot(aes(estimate, term, color=multiplier, xmin=conf.low,xmax = conf.high)) + 
    theme_classic()+
 
    geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge2(.9, padding = .1, reverse=TRUE), stat="identity")+
      geom_point(aes(color=multiplier),
  fill="black",alpha=0.3,pch=21, position = position_dodge2(.9, padding = .1, reverse=TRUE), stat="identity")  +
   scale_color_manual("Multiplier",values=pal6,labels = c('0x', '0.5x', '1x','2x','3x',"Original model"))+
    geom_vline(xintercept=0,lty=2)+
  labs(x = "Standardized coefficient",y =NULL, title="Probability of branch dieback")+
   scale_y_discrete(labels = c(expression(paste("TD"^"2")),"TD",expression(paste("SHM"^"2")),"SHM",expression(paste("MWMT"^"2")),"MWMT"))+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=11)))
ggsave(coefbrdb, file="SSMT_FH_brdb_Sensitivity_coefs_title.png", dpi=600, height=6, width=6)

coef6ind<- (coeftipdb |coefbrdb)/(coeftopdb|coefsnkbl)/(coefpbl|coefgall)
ggsave(coef6ind, file="SSMT_FH_6ind_Sensitivity_coefs_title.png", dpi=600, height=10.5, width=8.2)
```

### Multipanel
```{r,echo=FALSE}
Figbrdbsensmult <- (pbrdb0|plot_spacer())/(pbrdb05low|pbrdb05high)/(pbrdb1low|pbrdb1high)/(pbrdb2low|pbrdb2high)/(pbrdb3low|pbrdb3high)
Figbrdbsensmultann <- Figbrdbsensmult + plot_annotation(tag_levels = c("a"))

ggsave(Figbrdbsensmultann, file="SSMT_FH_branchdieback_pred_Sensitivity.png", dpi=600, height=10.5, width=7)
```
